title: Hold a motor dealer's licence
what: Hold a motor vehicle dealer's licence before carrying on the business of a dealer.

laws.title: Consumer Affairs and Fair Trading Act 1990 (NT)

sources.title: Consumer Affairs and Fair Trading Act 1990 (NT)
sources.quote: Subject to this Part, a person other than a licensed dealer must not: (a) carry on the business of a dealer; or (b) hold themselves out as a dealer.
